rule_description: Use clear, friendly, confident and helpful language. Avoid rude, aggressive, threatening or overly pushy wording.
example_violation: 'Buy now or regret it forever!'
recommended_correction: Use a helpful, respectful call to action.

rule_description: Use 'members' instead of 'users' in all customer-facing content.
example_violation: 'Our users love this feature.'
recommended_correction: Replace 'users' with 'members'.

rule_description: Do not promise guaranteed results, 100% success, or outcomes that cannot be substantiated.
example_violation: 'We guarantee 100% success.'
recommended_correction: Remove the guarantee and use a verified, evidence-based benefit.

rule_description: Only publish the latest approved price: ₹999/month. Any other price requires manager approval before publication.
example_violation: 'Subscribe for ₹799/month.'
recommended_correction: Correct the price to ₹999/month or request approval for a new price.

rule_description: Do not publish unverified negative statements, accusations or comparisons about competitors.
example_violation: 'Our competitor cheats every customer.'
recommended_correction: Remove the allegation or provide approved, verifiable comparative evidence.

rule_description: Never expose personal email addresses, phone numbers, home addresses, account IDs, passwords or confidential customer information.
example_violation: 'Contact the customer at private.person@example.com.'
recommended_correction: Remove personal information and use the official support channel.

rule_description: Informative images must include meaningful alternative text. Videos should include captions where applicable.
example_violation: An infographic is uploaded without alt text.
recommended_correction: Add concise alt text describing the important information in the image.

rule_description: Use only approved logos, brand colors, fonts, templates and current product screenshots.
example_violation: An old logo or deprecated dashboard screenshot is used.
recommended_correction: Replace it with the latest approved asset from the brand asset library.

rule_description: Clearly disclose paid partnerships, sponsorships, gifted products and other material relationships.
example_violation: A paid promotion is posted without a sponsorship disclosure.
recommended_correction: Add a clear and visible sponsorship disclosure before publication.

rule_description: Proofread content. Use professional English, consistent punctuation and approved spelling conventions.
example_violation: A public post contains repeated spelling errors.
recommended_correction: Correct spelling, grammar and punctuation before submission.

rule_description: Do not make medical, financial or legal guarantees or claims without approved evidence and required specialist review.
example_violation: 'This product will cure anxiety in seven days.'
recommended_correction: Block publication and escalate to the appropriate legal or compliance reviewer.

rule_description: Calls to action must be honest, respectful and non-coercive. Do not use misleading urgency or fear-based pressure.
example_violation: 'Click now or your account will be deleted.'
recommended_correction: Use a clear, truthful and non-threatening call to action.

rule_description: Use only facts, statistics, testimonials and performance figures supported by approved sources.
example_violation: 'Our service is trusted by 10 million people' without evidence.
recommended_correction: Attach an approved source or remove the unsupported statistic.

rule_description: Do not fabricate testimonials, ratings, endorsements or customer reviews. Obtain permission before using identifiable customer stories.
example_violation: A fictional customer review is presented as genuine.
recommended_correction: Remove fabricated material and verify permission for real testimonials.

rule_description: Do not disclose internal roadmaps, unreleased features, internal documents, financial results or confidential partner information.
example_violation: A draft reveals an unreleased product launch date.
recommended_correction: Remove confidential details and obtain explicit manager approval.

rule_description: Use images, music, videos, fonts and written material only when the organisation has the necessary rights or permissions.
example_violation: A campaign uses an unlicensed stock photograph.
recommended_correction: Replace the asset with licensed or approved material and record its source.

rule_description: Use respectful, inclusive language. Avoid discriminatory, demeaning or stereotypical descriptions of people or groups.
example_violation: Copy uses insulting or exclusionary language about a group.
recommended_correction: Rewrite using neutral, respectful and inclusive wording.

rule_description: Follow the approved campaign brief, platform-specific format, hashtags, naming conventions and publication requirements.
example_violation: A campaign uses an unapproved hashtag or outdated campaign name.
recommended_correction: Update the content to match the approved campaign brief.

rule_description: AI-generated text, images and claims must be checked by a human for accuracy, bias, rights, privacy and brand alignment before publication.
example_violation: AI-generated copy includes an invented product feature.
recommended_correction: Verify every claim and obtain human approval before publishing.

rule_description: Content marked as high or critical risk must not be published until the required reviewer and manager approvals are recorded.
example_violation: A critical-risk post is published while approval is pending.
recommended_correction: Keep publication blocked until all required approvals are complete.
